Based on the provided context, banks reported the impact of the FDIC special assessment as follows:

*   **Bank of America (Q4 2023):** Reported an FDIC special assessment of approximately $1.7 billion related to regional bank failures in March 2023, which impacted expenses in "all other."
*   **Wells Fargo (Q4 2023):** Included a $1.9 billion FDIC special assessment in its reported non-interest expense for the full year 2023. Excluding this item, expenses would have been $53.6 billion.
*   **Bank of America (Q4 2024 Context):** Noted that Q4 2023 expenses included the FDIC special assessment, which contributed to a 16% year-over-year decrease in reported expenses for Q4 2024 compared to the prior year period.
*   **Wells Fargo (First Half of 2024):** Reported $336 million of expense related to the FDIC special assessment in the first half of 2024, which was not anticipated in initial guidance and contributed to an increase in full-year non-interest expense expectations from approximately $52.6 billion to $54 billion.
